_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_per_player_combat_damage.py. Each is a creatures_deal_combat_damage trigger with per_player, fanned out once per damaged seat: t_ppc_draw counts the firings; t_ppc_drain reads 'that player' through the defender binding; t_ppc_others is 'each other opponent', the opponents other than the bound one; t_ppc_shatter targets an artifact the bound player controls. The bodies are t_bcd_wyrm and t_bcd_elf from batched_combat_damage.cards.json.

cards.name: Test Per-Seat Wyrm Flock
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to a player, draw a card.

cards.name: Test Per-Seat Wyrm Leech
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, that player loses 5 life.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, that player loses 5 life.

cards.name: Test Per-Seat Wyrm Spite
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, this enchantment deals 4 damage to each other opponent.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, this enchantment deals 4 damage to each other opponent.

cards.name: Test Per-Seat Wyrm Shatter
cards.oracle_text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, destroy target artifact that opponent controls.

abilities.text: Whenever one or more Wyrms you control deal combat damage to an opponent, destroy target artifact that opponent controls.
